made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/orilla-sheet-make.js, from orilla-set.html (window.ORILLA.E) and the design of La orilla (the orchestrator's p7-spec, section orilla). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 78. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the water's edge at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 78 + 13 v - 22.5 z. The picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62; v from -6 (above the horizon, v -4.6) to 10.62
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the sand or the shallow water; z 0.84: a tower's top; z 1.45: the rope) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): the shells, the toy boats, the pile, the basket, the fishing boat have their bottom middle on the spot; a towel on the rope hangs with its top middle on it. scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up, 41 for a child; the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); Canelo sitting mkPerro('sit') (30 x 22): column 15 and its bottom edge. Whoever sits or kneels on the sand (abuela.foto, abuela.arena, manta_abuela, luis.botes, castillo_l, castillo_r): no maker draws a person on the sand (today's sitting sprites are drawn for a seat, their legs hang below the lap and the ground would hide them), so the stand-in is today's sitting drawing cut off just below the hips and given an outline row, its bottom edge on sy (open point: the real art). A small thing: see spot. Nobody is turned: the makers draw everyone from the front
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character. The set is taken at frame(0): the depth of window.DEPTH.live() (the palms' fronds drawn in), not the baked one, so a frond in front of a spot covers it
rules.boat: the fishing boat: a sprite 34 x 20 with its bottom middle on spot bote (BOAT u 2.5, v -3.5). The set draws a boat there only with bote = 1 (for the readers' renders: preview moments 3 and 4 use it); in the game it is the sprite
rules.shells: a pink shell: 6 x 6 (the spec gives the width; the height is a stand-in); the three of a row (conchas, conchas73) are 8 px from middle to middle: the row is 22 x 6, its bottom middle on the spot; spots.*.parts lists the three boxes. A shell on a tower has its bottom middle on torre1 / torre3
rules.towels: a towel on the rope (cuerda1, cuerda2): 14 wide, 16 high, hanging below the point: the box [sx - 7, sy, 14, 16]; toalla_a hangs at cuerda1 and toalla_b at cuerda2

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the set's depth at frame(0), the palms' fronds in, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the palms' trunks and fronds, the castle's towers hide whoever is behind them.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where live[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (live: window.DEPTH.live() of the set page after frame(0)). The same rule as El calendario's sheet: the upright plane through the feet (a towel on the rope: the plane through its top, on the rope)
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn (the frog is the last layer of every moment)

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the ground (z 0), through frame(t, casts). The spec gives no radius: these are El calendario's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28, the dog .3) (open point)
shadows.onTop: whoever stands above the ground (the frog on a tower: z above 0) casts none: a shadow cast at the sand under him would show in front of the castle
